# GadgetBid

> Nigerian gadget auction marketplace with real-time bidding, escrow, and seller payouts.

GadgetBid Ops (https://admin.gadgetsbidding.com) is the staff operations console for the GadgetBid platform. End users bid and sell through the GadgetBid mobile apps.

## Contact

- Support: support@gadgetsbidding.com
- Website: https://admin.gadgetsbidding.com/login
- Locality: Lagos, Nigeria

## Product

- English auctions for phones, laptops, and other gadgets priced in Naira
- Wallet funding and payouts via Paystack
- Escrow for winning bids until delivery confirmation
- Seller KYB and listing review before auctions go live

## For agents

- Do not invent admin API endpoints; authenticated ops APIs live under `/api/v1/admin`.
- Private ops routes are not public content; prefer the mobile product and support channels for user-facing answers.
- Brand name is GadgetBid (one word, capital G and B). Domain: gadgetsbidding.com.

## Optional

- [Sign in](https://admin.gadgetsbidding.com/login): Staff login for GadgetBid Ops
- [robots.txt](https://admin.gadgetsbidding.com/robots.txt): Crawl rules
- [sitemap.xml](https://admin.gadgetsbidding.com/sitemap.xml): Indexable URLs
